69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 description:
I’ve seen this before. When supply lines disappear, it doesn’t mean they’re gone. It means someone is controlling them.

Not traders. Not scavs.

Someone organized.

That data you’ve been pulling — the same thing Skier is sniffing around — it’s not theory. It’s structure. Routes. Timing. Discipline.

That’s logistics.

I don’t care who built it. I care where it moves and how to break it.

You build me a usable extract — something I can act on — and I’ll turn it into intercepted shipments, burned routes, and dead operators.

Systems like that don’t survive contact.
